::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The English record forms and instructions are translations of the original Italian test, provided for use and cross-cultural adaptation. The normative data and cut-offs come from the Italian sample.
:::

### Psychometric properties

| Property | Result |
|---|---|
| Internal consistency | Cronbach's α = 0.81 |
| Test-retest reliability (GEMS-A, n = 52) | r = 0.845 |
| Parallel forms (GEMS-A vs GEMS-B, n = 59) | r = 0.774, no practice effect |
| Convergent validity (n = 60) | MoCA r = 0.723; ENB-2 r = 0.811 |
| Discriminant validity (49 patients with Parkinson's disease) | AUC = 0.786 (95% CI 0.716–0.856) |
| Norms | Regression-based cut-offs for age, sex, education and Cognitive Reserve Index |
| Follow-up | Thresholds for significant change over time |
: {.props}

**Tasks:** orientation, immediate memory, backward months, puzzle, clock, delayed memory, naming, comprehension, attention, verbal fluency, metaphor comprehension.
